environment.description: Same EC2 instance (m5.large) running identical Flask application, but fronted by AWS API Gateway (REST API type) with a request validator attached to the POST /api/v1/users method. The validator uses a JSON Schema model that enforces: 'email' must match pattern '^[^@\\s]{1,64}@[^@\\s]{1,255}$' with maxLength 320, 'username' must match '^[a-zA-Z0-9._]{1,64}$', and 'comment' field has maxLength of 1000 characters and must match pattern '^[\\w\\s,;]{0,1000}$'. The GET /api/v1/users/search method has a request parameter validator requiring 'q' to match '^[a-zA-Z0-9@._+]{1,128}$'. Request validation is set to 'Validate body, query string parameters, and headers'. The API Gateway integration uses VPC Link to the EC2 instance. API Gateway has a 29-second integration timeout but the schema validation rejects non-conforming payloads before they reach the backend.

config.request_validator: Validate body, query string parameters, and headers
